approach: Record the existing setup path (setup.sh handing off to `cargo run --locked --release -p xtask -- setup`) as OLY-B-RUN-02's mechanism in docs/spec.toml, with a measure naming the new test and ending `status: not shown`. Add xtask/tests/setup_repeatable.rs, which reads the committed files and asserts the spec entry, the pinned and checksummed rustup-init, the exact toolchain channel, the single locked `exec cargo run` ending, and the skip-if-present guards, plus a blanked-mechanism case. Add a test in hestia.rs (the OLY-B-O1-01 precedent at hestia.rs:4337) that runs the real `parse_spec` and `spec_gaps`. Register the new test target in xtask/shard-timings.txt, because `checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit` (xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs:411) fails otherwise. Add a CHANGELOG.md line. No dev-dependency is added to xtask, so Cargo.lock and the `crate xtask` line in docs/system-facts.md stay as they are. setup.sh, rust-toolchain.toml, athena.toml and xtask behavior are not changed.

decisions.choice: Test in xtask/tests/setup_repeatable.rs parses docs/spec.toml with toml+serde (already xtask dev-dependencies, xtask/Cargo.toml:21-26), as xtask/tests/spec.rs does. xtask/Cargo.toml is not changed.
decisions.reason: Adding athena-core as an xtask dev-dependency would change Cargo.lock (the xtask entry at Cargo.lock:978-995 lists its dependencies, and checks run with --locked). It would also change the `- crate xtask: bin; deps data git; dev context testkit` line in docs/system-facts.md, which `system_facts_crate_lines_match_manifests` (crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs:274) pins. That is four more files, two of them Cargo files that criterion 5 excludes.

rejected.option: Add athena-core as a dev-dependency of xtask and call hestia::spec_gaps from the xtask test
rejected.why: Touches Cargo.lock and docs/system-facts.md, and fails the criterion 5 limit on Cargo files. The real-function check is covered by the hestia.rs test instead.

rejected.option: Build a new setup path or script
rejected.why: buy-first: setup.sh plus `xtask setup` already is the one command. Changing it is out of scope.

decisions.choice: The real-spec gap check with the real `hestia::spec_gaps` goes in a new test in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs, next to the OLY-B-O1-01 and OLY-B-SET-04 tests. The xtask test keeps only a small local blank-or-none rule for its blanked-copy case.
decisions.reason: The gap rule lives in hestia.rs (`spec_gaps` at 1291, `blank_or_none` at 1206). Testing it there uses the production function with the real spec text through `include_str!`, which is the existing precedent. hestia.rs is a listed deliverable.

rejected.option: Only the xtask test, with the gap rule copied into it
rejected.why: The copied rule would be the logic under test inside the test. The hestia.rs test covers the production rule, and the xtask test covers the file contents.

decisions.choice: Add `xtask --test setup_repeatable 5.00` to xtask/shard-timings.txt, in sorted position between `policy` and `site_page`.
decisions.reason: `checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit` (xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs:411-421) compares the file's units with the workspace test targets, so a new test file without a line fails `cargo test`. The OLY-B-O1-01 changelog entry (CHANGELOG.md:23) did the same for its new test file.

rejected.option: Run `cargo run -p xtask -- shard-timings` to measure it
rejected.why: It runs every test unit and rewrites the whole file, which is far more churn than one estimated line; the 5.00 estimate matches the `walltime` and `xtask --bin` lines.

decisions.choice: The measure ends `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p xtask --test setup_repeatable` and `cargo test -p athena-core oly_b_run_02`.
decisions.reason: No `athena status` line reports setup repeatability. `measure_problem` (hestia.rs:1219) accepts `status: not shown`, and `STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS` has no matching label.

rejected.why: Out of scope in the brief.

decisions.choice: Add a CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased > Added.
decisions.reason: It is a listed deliverable and a user default. Earlier mechanism jobs did the same (CHANGELOG.md:12-23).

rejected.option: Skip the changelog because criterion 5 lists only two files
rejected.why: Criterion 5 conflicts with the deliverable list. The changelog is a user default and a listed deliverable, so it is kept, and the conflict is stated in risks.

files.purpose: Fill OLY-B-RUN-02's mechanism and measure (lines 2305-2307): the mechanism names setup.sh and xtask/src/main.rs, its pins and limits; the measure names the two tests and ends `status: not shown`. Owner stays `Athena`. Use no double quotes or backslashes inside the strings.

File-reading tests for the setup path: the spec entry, the pinned and checksummed rustup-init, the exact toolchain channel, the single locked `exec cargo run` ending, the skip-if-present guards, the athena.toml gitleaks pin, and the blanked-mechanism case.
Test only: add `oly_b_run_02_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list` after line 4364, modeled on `oly_b_o1_01_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list` (4337). No production code changes.

steps: Read docs/spec.toml lines 2303-2316 and edit only the `mechanism` and `measure` lines of OLY-B-RUN-02. Mechanism (one TOML basic string, no double quotes or backslashes): setup.sh is the one command. It finds cargo on PATH or in CARGO_HOME; only when cargo is missing it fetches a rustup-init pinned to RUSTUP_VERSION 1.28.2, checks it against a committed per-platform sha256 and refuses to run on a mismatch. It then ends in `exec cargo run --quiet --locked --release -p xtask -- setup`. `setup` in xtask/src/main.rs (the `setup` function at line 181) reads the other pins from athena.toml (gitleaks version and per-platform sha256, sccache version, claude_version) and the toolchain from rust-toolchain.toml (channel 1.97.0), runs `cargo fetch --locked`, skips gitleaks and sccache when the pinned version is already installed (`gitleaks_present`, `install_sccache_at`), and reads credentials only to report them, never storing them. Limits: it needs network, git 2.40 or later, cc and curl; it refuses to run inside an Athena job (ATHENA_NESTED); the hooks and Claude Code steps are not covered by the test; the test reads the files and does not run a fresh-machine setup; no `athena status` line prints it. Measure: names `cargo test -p xtask --test setup_repeatable` (the pins, the checksum, the exact channel and the single locked command) and `cargo test -p athena-core oly_b_run_02_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list`, and ends exactly `status: not shown`. Keep owner = "Athena".

Create xtask/tests/setup_repeatable.rs (header comment in the style of xtask/tests/spec.rs). Copy the helpers `root()` and a minimal serde `Spec` with `requirement: Vec<Req>`. `Req` has id, status (String) and `#[serde(default)]` mechanism, owner, measure, with no `deny_unknown_fields` so source tables are ignored. Tests: `the_spec_entry_names_the_setup_path_owner_and_test` (active, owner `Athena`, mechanism not blank or none, contains `setup.sh` and `xtask/src/main.rs`, every regex token `[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(sh|rs|toml)` in the mechanism is a file under root, measure contains `setup_repeatable` and `oly_b_run_02`, and ends with `status: not shown`); `setup_sh_pins_rustup_and_checks_its_sha256` (RUSTUP_VERSION matches `^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$`, four `sum=[0-9a-f]{64}` arms, the URL uses `$RUSTUP_VERSION`, the mismatch refusal line is present, and the text has no `latest` or pipe-to-sh install); `the_toolchain_channel_is_an_exact_version`; `setup_sh_ends_in_one_locked_cargo_run` (exactly one line starting `exec `, it is the last non-blank non-comment line, and it contains `cargo run`, `--locked`, `-p xtask` and ends `-- setup "$@"`); `the_rustup_install_runs_only_when_cargo_is_missing` (the download and `rustup-init` lines come after `if ! command -v cargo`); `the_other_pins_are_exact` (athena.toml `[tools.gitleaks]` version is x.y.z and its four sha256 values are 64 hex; main.rs contains `fn gitleaks_present` and `already installed`); `blanking_the_mechanism_makes_the_entry_a_gap` (clone the real entry, set mechanism to `none`, an empty string and `None`; each is blank-or-none; the real one is not). Avoid unwrap-style lints the workspace denies; follow the style of xtask/tests/spec.rs.
Add the line `xtask --test setup_repeatable 5.00` to xtask/shard-timings.txt between `xtask --test policy 10.00` and `xtask --test site_page 30.00`.

In crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs tests, after `oly_b_o1_01_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list` (ends line 4364), add `oly_b_run_02_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list`: `parse_spec(include_str!("../../../docs/spec.toml"))`, find OLY-B-RUN-02, assert the mechanism is not `none` and contains `setup.sh` and `xtask/src/main.rs`, the owner is `Athena`, `measure_problem` is None, the measure ends `status: not shown` and contains `setup_repeatable`, and `spec_gaps` has no entry for the id. Then set `mechanism = "none"` on a clone and assert `spec_gaps(&[without])` has one entry with `no_mechanism`.

Add an Unreleased > Added bullet at the top of CHANGELOG.md (after the OLY-B-RUN-01 bullet at line 12 or above it): OLY-B-RUN-02 now has a mechanism, setup.sh handing off to `xtask setup`; its measure ends `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p xtask --test setup_repeatable`; the new test file is registered in `xtask/shard-timings.txt` with a 5.00 s estimate; setup behavior is unchanged.

Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test -p xtask --test setup_repeatable`, `cargo test -p xtask --test spec`, `cargo test -p xtask --test ci_shards`, `cargo test -p xtask --test policy`, `cargo test -p athena-core oly_b_run_02`, then `cargo test --locked`. Check that `git status` shows only the five files above.

risks.risk: Criterion 5 says only docs/spec.toml and the new test file change, but the deliverable list also names xtask/Cargo.toml, CHANGELOG.md and hestia.rs, and `cargo test` needs the shard-timings line.
risks.mitigation: The plan changes docs/spec.toml, the new test file, a test-only hunk in hestia.rs, one line in xtask/shard-timings.txt and CHANGELOG.md. It leaves xtask/Cargo.toml unchanged (no dev-dependency is needed). No governance file changes, which is what criterion 5 protects. The deviation is stated here for the verifier.

risks.risk: The tests assert on the text of setup.sh and xtask/src/main.rs, which is brittle against harmless rewording, and they do not run a fresh-machine setup. Idempotence of the hooks and Claude Code steps is not demonstrated.
risks.mitigation: Assert only on stable, deliberate markers: `RUSTUP_VERSION=`, `sum=` with 64 hex digits, the `exec cargo run` line, `gitleaks_present` and `already installed`. The mechanism text lists the limits (network and git, cc, curl required; hooks and Claude Code steps not covered). The measure says `status: not shown`, so it does not claim a run.

risks.risk: The xtask blanked-mechanism case uses a local blank-or-none rule, a copy of `hestia::blank_or_none` (hestia.rs:1206) and `crates/xtask/tests/spec.rs:185`.
risks.mitigation: The criterion-3 gap assertion on the production rule is made in the hestia.rs test with the real `spec_gaps`. The xtask case only shows the real entry is not blank.

risks.risk: The mechanism text could break the TOML parse or the boundary scan if it contains quotes, backslashes or banned words.
risks.mitigation: Keep it ASCII with no double quotes or backslashes; `the_real_spec_passes` and the policy scan in cargo test catch a slip.

demonstrations.method: Two tests read the committed docs/spec.toml. The xtask test checks the entry; the hestia.rs test runs the real `parse_spec` and `spec_gaps` over it.
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p xtask --test setup_repeatable the_spec_entry_names_the_setup_path_owner_and_test && cargo test -p athena-core oly_b_run_02_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list
demonstrations.observes: The xtask test finds OLY-B-RUN-02 active with owner `Athena`. Its mechanism is not `none` and names setup.sh and xtask/src/main.rs, and every file path in it is a file under the repository root. Its measure names `setup_repeatable` and ends with `status: not shown`. The hestia.rs test finds `measure_problem` is None and no `SpecGap` for the id.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the mechanism `none`, the xtask test fails its not-`none` and names-setup.sh assertions, and the hestia.rs test fails `!spec_gaps(..).iter().any(|g| g.id == r.id)`.
demonstrations.seam: No seam is needed. docs/spec.toml is read from disk through `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/..` (the xtask/tests/spec.rs:87-97 pattern, exists) and through `include_str!("../../../docs/spec.toml")` in hestia.rs (the pattern at hestia.rs:4338, exists). Entry points: `toml::from_str` in the xtask test and `hestia::parse_spec` and `spec_gaps` in hestia.rs. Step 2 adds the xtask test and step 4 adds the hestia.rs test.

demonstrations.method: The test file reads setup.sh, rust-toolchain.toml, athena.toml and xtask/src/main.rs from the repository root and asserts on their text. It does not run setup.
demonstrations.observes: (a) `RUSTUP_VERSION=` is an exact x.y.z and the rustup-init URL uses `$RUSTUP_VERSION`. (b) setup.sh has four `sum=<64 hex>` entries (one per platform) and refuses to run on `[ "$actual" = "$sum" ]` failing. (c) The `channel` in rust-toolchain.toml matches `^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$`. (d) The last non-comment line of setup.sh is the only `exec` line and is `exec cargo run ... --locked ... -p xtask -- setup`. (e) The rustup install sits inside the `if ! command -v cargo` guard. (f) athena.toml `[tools.gitleaks]` has an exact version and four 64-hex sha256 values. (g) xtask/src/main.rs has the skip-if-present guards `gitleaks_present` and `already installed`.
demonstrations.fails_without: Each assertion fails on its own mutation: a version without a checksum, a `latest` channel, or a second `exec` line. With the spec mechanism `none`, the spec-entry test fails.
demonstrations.seam: Files are read from disk by repository-relative path using `Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).parent()`. This is the same `root()` as xtask/tests/spec.rs:87-92 (exists). `toml` and `regex` are already dev-dependencies (xtask/Cargo.toml:24-26). Step 2 adds the file.

demonstrations.method: The first test passes on the committed spec. Its `blanking_the_mechanism_makes_the_entry_a_gap` case parses the real spec, clones the OLY-B-RUN-02 entry, sets the mechanism to `none`, an empty string and `None`, and asserts the entry is then a gap while the real one is not. The hestia.rs test does the same with the real `spec_gaps` and asserts `gaps.len() == 1 && gaps[0].no_mechanism`.
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p xtask --test setup_repeatable && cargo test -p athena-core oly_b_run_02_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list
demonstrations.observes: Both commands pass. The blanked copy is a gap and the real entry is not, so the gap assertion would fail if the committed mechanism were `none`.
demonstrations.fails_without: With `mechanism = "none"` committed, `the_spec_entry_names_the_setup_path_owner_and_test` and the hestia.rs not-a-gap assertion both fail. The blanked-copy case shows the same rule flags `none`, an empty string and `None`.
demonstrations.seam: The xtask case uses an in-memory copy of the entry parsed from the real file (no fixture file). In hestia.rs, `spec_gaps(&[without])` takes the real entry with only its `mechanism` field replaced, as the test at hestia.rs:4358-4363 does (exists). Steps 2 and 4 add the cases.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks Athena runs. `cargo test --locked` includes xtask/tests/spec.rs (`the_real_spec_passes`, `every_active_requirement_has_a_mechanism_an_owner_and_a_measure`), ci_shards.rs (`checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit`), policy.rs (boundary-word scan, which reads the tracked files) and the athena-core tests.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three exit 0. The timings file lists `xtask --test setup_repeatable`, the spec still parses with the new strings, and the boundary scan finds nothing in the new text.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the timings line, `checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit` fails. A mechanism or measure string that breaks the TOML makes `the_real_spec_passes` fail.
demonstrations.seam: None; these are the real checks. The new test file must be clippy-clean under the workspace lints (`[lints] workspace = true`, xtask/Cargo.toml:28-29), so it avoids unwrap-style lints the same way tests/spec.rs does.
